description: AFK+ instruction intake (services/afk-agent/README.md, 'Instruction intake'; services/cloud-afk/README.md, 'AFK+ trade orders'). 'rules': the free rule check of a typed order: 'result' is 'ok', 'question:rmt' (money words that may be the server's own money: the player says whether they are, then the check runs again with 'inGame'), 'question:limit' (stored only with a limit) or 'reject:<reason>' / 'reject:loosen:<rule>'; 'notes' the card's notes; 'ctx' the account's counters and caps ('maxDeal', 'active', 'orderMax', 'minute', 'today', 'perDay'; left out: the generic profile's 100,000,000, none, 10, none, none, 20), the server's money name ('currency': the profile's money.label, else the player's trade.currency) and 'inGame' (true: the player said the text's money is the game's). 'readers': how the agent reads the model's quotes ('amount' with maxDeal, 'count' with the stack size, 'level' with the enchantment's max, 'pct', 'days'); null: not read, the field counts as not said; 'quoted': whether the quote ('text') is a part of the typed text ('arg') in whole tokens, the check every quote passes first. 'drafts': the model's answer ('parse', schema order-v1) with the candidates the context gave it ('cands') and the account's context ('ctx'; 'trades': 'owner' where the owner makes the trades, else the bot; 'currency' and 'inGame' as the rules'; the model's 'rmt' flag refuses with a rail in the text, goes where the text's only money is the server's own name or 'inGame', and is 'question:rmt' otherwise) as a draft, its questions in order (clients show the first two) and notes, or 'reject'; 'order' what the finished draft saves as (null while questions remain). 'answers': a chip's effect on a draft ('from' names the draft case, 'question' the one answered): the new draft and questions, a settings change saved with the order, or 'form' / 'pick' (the chip opens the form or the inventory picker). 'data' is a synthetic format-1 item data file (FREE-ITEMS' pl_items::data), not the game's. Generated by generate-afkplus-intake-v1.mjs from hand-written expectations checked against afkplus-intake.mjs; do not edit by hand.
